summary: ACCEPT. Re-pinned at a content-identical new head after I invalidated the previous record. Moves the armed-segment pager's internal ET guard from 420 (07:00 ET) to 360 (06:00 ET). WHY THERE IS A NEW HEAD AT ALL, recorded against myself: the operator confirmed the selftest notification arrived on his device, and I AMENDED THE EXISTING PIN RECORD IN PLACE to close the stated delivery gap. The gate refused -- review_pin_gate.py:165 requires EXACTLY ONE commit per record path and `record` refuses an existing destination. Pin records are WRITE-ONCE and there is no amend or supersede path. My reasoning was that an unmerged PR left the record mutable; that is FALSE -- immutability is keyed to the record being WRITTEN, not to the PR merging. The gate caught a reviewer silently editing a pin after the fact, which is exactly what it exists to catch, and it was right to. No force-push was used to hide it; the invalid record is dropped in this same commit and the trail stands. CONTENT VERIFIED IDENTICAL TO THE REVIEWED HEAD, not taken on report: old tree and new tree are both 1156b003acd6579211faafea7584aeb189c9b168, git diff between the heads is empty, base 30998cd5 is the current main tip and an ancestor of the head, and I recomputed git patch-id --stable myself getting 443f461b4dd0b4f54df630623d3f66c5a45f454c. Nothing was re-reviewed on faith; the object is the same object. THE DEFECT THIS FIXES WAS MINE. In #842 I asked for the CRON schedule to widen from 11-21 to 10-21 UTC to buy an hour of pre-open warning, codex agreed with my reasoning, and NEITHER OF US GREPPED THE CALLEE. The wrapper carried its own guard refusing anything before 07:00 ET, so the widened cron fired 06:00-07:00 ET and exited 0 silently every time. Configured, not enforced -- a dead guard dominated by an earlier return. VERIFIED BY EXECUTED MUTATION, RUN NATIVELY ON LINUX in a throwaway clone (a Windows run is void for a shell script; established on #842 where path-form mangling produced a false negative I nearly reported as contradicting the author). Baseline 3 collected cases passed. Mutant reverting 360 back to 420: 2 failed, 1 passed, killed by test_wrapper_opens_exactly_at_0600_et[06-00-True] AND by test_wrapper_header_names_the_effective_schedule_and_window. Restore hash-verified byte-identical; clone removed. THE BOUNDARY CONTROL IS GENUINELY TWO-WAY: parametrized [(05,59,False),(06,00,True)], one variable, both outcomes reachable. ⭐ THE HEADER COMMENT IS ITSELF PINNED BY A TEST, the most valuable part of this PR. That header had gone stale twice, still documenting the 11-21 cron line and a 07:00-16:30 window; a stale contract comment is what let the false _fetch_open_positions docstring survive into #843, and this makes that rot non-silent. ✅ THE NOTIFICATION PATH IS PROVEN END TO END. The operator confirmed on his own device that the armed-segments SELFTEST notification ARRIVED. SELFTEST_RC=0 and the cron.log 'SELFTEST push sent' line prove INVOCATION ONLY -- that line is written unconditionally on the line immediately after the call, so it is identical whether or not anything was delivered. Only a recipient can close a delivery question. FULL CHAIN NOW VERIFIED, and three of its four links were separately broken this week: #841 script correct (verified against the live sudoers, was returning UNKNOWN on every call), #842 scheduled at all (there was NO cron entry, no timer, no unit, for any user), #844 window actually reaches the event, and DELIVERY confirmed by a human. Each link looked fine from the one above it. NOT MEASURED: only the focused test file was mutated; no full-suite run by me; no mutant probed the 990 upper bound or the holiday list. ⛔ DEPLOY: ops-only, NOT sync-only eligible, explicit copy required, no service restart, and do NOT re-run the schedule installer -- the cron line is unchanged by this PR.
